name: Götznerhof
beschreibung: The Götznerhof is located in the municipality of Götzens in Tirol. The hotel has various rooms and suites. Guests have access to a restaurant and a wellness area. The location near Innsbruck makes trips into the city and the mountains possible. In summer, the accommodation is ideal for hiking; in winter, for ski excursions. The hotel also offers seminar rooms for events.
